sources.title: Como criar e editar sua página de usuário na Wikipédia.webm
Como utilizar páginas de teste na Wikipédia.webm

selection: Four additional named instructional sources selected using official Commons metadata after the initial 21-window screen, before viewing/scoring these four originals. Exploratory follow-up; no representative recall.
rule: For each original, prepare 12 seconds at floor(min(duration-12,600)*q) for q=.25,.5,.75. This covers distinct points in the app-supported first ten minutes, avoiding duplicated capped timestamps on long recordings. Retain all 12 outcomes. Never add a defect. Inspect proposals for teaching meaning before independent HTTP export qualification.
phase: Frozen v5 baseline; later source-driven fixes are development, not held-out validation.
